visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a young woman's right eye. She has long, curled eyelashes and is holding a black mascara remover wand, applying it to her lashes. She wears silver hair clips and has bright pink lipstick. Blue variety text with numbers appears in circles. (2) The woman holds a white circular makeup remover pad to her eye, pressing firmly. She then pulls it away to reveal black mascara residues in the shape of eyelashes on the pad. The background is a brightly lit indoor room with shelves and crystals. (3) She holds a purple Chiikawa brand makeup bag and two pink Maybelline mascara tubes towards the camera. She smiles and points to her eyes, showing the length of her lashes. (4) A macro close-up of the mascara remover's curved, comb-like applicator wand held against a white hand. The wand is wet with a clear solution. (5) The woman applies the product again in a close-up, focusing on the outer corner of her eye. She then uses a clean cotton pad to wipe the eye area, showing a clean result. (6) A split-screen appears showing her applying the product on the left and a promotional graphic for the Chiikawa bag on the right. She holds the purple bag up to her face, looking excited. (7) She demonstrates a cleaning tip by wiping the used applicator wand on a clean cotton pad before putting it back into the pink tube. She smiles at the camera as the video concludes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking with high energy and a bright, friendly tone. Upbeat electronic BGM with a strong four-on-the-floor beat kicks in immediately. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX sounds as the speaker emphasizes a point about the product's speed. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) A soft 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs between speech segments. The speaker's pace increases while describing the applicator's features, with a percussive 'click' audible as she opens a tube. (4) A 'Pop' sound effect plays when a text graphic appears on screen. The vocal intensity remains high and persuasive. (5) A cartoonish 'slide' SFX accompanies the demonstration of the cotton pad wipe. The BGM maintains a consistent, joyful major-mode melody. (6) A final 'ding' and a shimmering synth stinger mark the end of the promotional segment and the start of the final cleaning tip. The speech concludes with a warm, rising intonation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Feature -> Demonstration -> Promotion -> Expert Tip
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review and tutorial for Maybelline's mascara remover. It aims to showcase the product's effectiveness and ease of use through a direct demonstration, while also incentivizing purchases through a limited-time promotional offer involving popular character merchandise (Chiikawa).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, display of brand logos (Maybelline), mention of a specific promotional price and gift with purchase.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished, social-media native video utilizing fast cuts, vibrant text overlays, and popular character collaborations to drive engagement in the beauty sector.
